content: Prisma 7 in a Turborepo+pnpm monorepo: dedicated packages/db (@repo/db) package owns schema.prisma with generator output='../generated/prisma'; turbo.json needs an explicit db:generate task (cache:false) as dependsOn of build (^build,^db:generate) and dev (^db:generate); consuming apps import via @repo/db workspace:* which re-exports the instantiated PrismaClient + generated types from an index.ts.
